$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, generated from this interface by ../scripts/schema.ts: for editors.

updated.description: When the data was last edited (YYYY-MM-DD).

asOf.description: When each kind of number was collected, which crawl.ts does daily, and when the tags were assigned (YYYY-MM-DD).

Data.description: The shape of ../data/skills.json, the single data file behind the site: the approved skills, the ones it shows. The skills the crawl found but that aren't approved are in ../data/crawl.json, as `Crawl` in ../scripts/data.ts describes.

count.description: How many values of this facet a skill carries.

label.description: A name for chips, when the id alone isn't one.

includes.description: Makes the value a parent of these values of the same facet: skills don't carry it, they have it through any of them, and filtering on it lists them all.

prefix.description: `false` for topics, which are written without a `topic:` prefix.

Facet.description: A tag dimension. Tags are written `facet:value`, except topics, which have no prefix.

kind.description: `skills`: exists to ship skills. `project`: a product that also ships a skill. `index`: a curated list or catalog.

stars.description: GitHub stars, or null when unknown. crawl.ts refreshes them for the repos of approved skills and bundles.

leaderboardSkills.description: How many of the repo's skills were in the skills.sh all-time top 600.

id.description: The GitHub repo, `owner/name`, or `owner/name@part` for one of several bundles in a repo.

description.description: One sentence, shown until it has a TLDR.

tldr.description: What the bundle is and how its skills work together, written from the repo at its permalink's commit.

skills.description: Its skills, in the order they're used.

skew.description: Words added plus words removed across its skills' SKILL.md since the commit the TLDR summarizes, or all their words when there's no TLDR.

Bundle.description: Skills of one repo meant to be installed together, such as the steps of a workflow. Its skills are listed inside its entry; those worth installing alone also get an entry of their own.

glance.description: Short labelled facts to place the skill quickly, most telling first, such as "Use it when".

text.description: Prose that explains what the skill does.

permalink.description: GitHub permalink to what the TLDR summarizes: the skill's directory at a commit. For a bundle, its repo at a commit.

standalone.description: Whether it's worth installing alone, with no other skill of the bundle: then it also gets an entry of its own in the skills list. A skill that loads another one of the bundle, or only works on another's output, isn't.

note.description: For a skill that isn't standalone: what it needs from the rest of the bundle.

id.description: Unique: where the skill's SKILL.md lives, as the GitHub repo and the directory inside it, `owner/name/path/to/dir` (just `owner/name` for a SKILL.md at the root). The repo has an entry in `repos`.

tldr.description: What the skill is and does, written from the SKILL.md its permalink points to.

skillMd.description: The copy of the skill's SKILL.md at `data/skill-snapshots/<id>.md`, which `sync.ts` keeps current.

Skill.description: A skill on GitHub that skills.sh lists. SkillHub lists no other skills.

installs.description: All-time installs, or null when unknown: exact for the skills.sh all-time top 600, else from the skill's skills.sh page, which rounds them to three digits (such as 26.5K).

weeklyInstalls.description: Installs per week for the 8 weeks up to the installs snapshot, oldest first.

firstSeen.description: When skills.sh first saw the skill (YYYY-MM-DD).

version.description: The GitHub commit the copy was taken from.

skew.description: Words added plus words removed since the SKILL.md the TLDR summarizes, or all its words when there's no TLDR.
